about: About a minute of planning talk, used to change devices mid-meeting: the app window is minimized, the microphone is unplugged and plugged back in, and the speakers switch to headphones. Sarah (the user) is on the microphone; Alice and Bob are remote.
windowTitle: Website launch sync | Meeting | Microsoft Teams

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: Thanks for joining. This is the website launch sync.

lines.speaker: Bob
lines.text: The new landing page is finished and it passed review yesterday.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Great. I still need to check the pricing table on mobile.

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: Sarah, can you check the pricing table by Wednesday?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Yes, I'll check the pricing table by Wednesday.

lines.speaker: Bob
lines.text: I'll send the press release to the marketing team by Thursday.

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: Let's launch the website on the fifteenth.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: It works for me too. I'll update the help center articles before the launch.

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: Perfect. We are launching on the fifteenth. Thanks, everyone.
